title: EvoSkill v2: Fully Agentic Skill Evolution from Benchmark Adaptation to a Stateful Evolver
abstract: arXiv:2610.25931v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: EvoSkill v2 is a three-agent system that edits the instructions (skills) an agent is given, leaving its model and harness intact. The user starts a run by describing a benchmark and supplying a grader, which a benchmark adaptor turns into a benchmark-specific plugin. A solver attempts the tasks, and an evolver reads the solver's training rollouts and rewrites the skills at each epoch. We implement the evolver as one stateful coding agent with a bash tool for the whole run, unlike the two most common designs among the skill optimizers we surveyed: a sequence of single model calls, as in SkillOpt, and an agent that starts afresh each round, as in SkillBoost. We also measure how much the solver's rollouts vary from one attempt to the next, give the evolver several attempts per training task, and accept every epoch's skills instead of selecting among them on noisy scores. translated_title: EvoSkill v2：从基准适配到有状态演化器的全智能体技能演化
translated_abstract: EvoSkill v2 是一个三智能体系统，它通过编辑智能体所获得的指令（技能）来提升性能，同时保持其底层模型和运行框架不变。用户通过描述一个基准测试并提供一个评分器来启动运行，基准适配器会将其转换为针对该基准的专用插件。求解器尝试完成任务，演化器则读取求解器的训练轨迹并在每个周期重写技能。我们将演化器实现为一个带有 bash 工具、在整个运行过程中持续存在的有状态编码智能体，这不同于我们所调研的技能优化器中最常见的两种设计：如 SkillOpt 那样的一系列单次模型调用，以及如 SkillBoost 那样每轮从零开始的智能体。我们还测量了求解器的轨迹在多次尝试之间的变化程度，为演化器提供每个训练任务的多次尝试机会，并直接接受每个周期产生的技能，而不是依据嘈杂的分数在其中进行筛选。在细粒度真实标签的条件下，EvoSkill v2 的技能将……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: EvoSkill v2 提出了一种由三个智能体组成的技能演化系统，其核心创新在于采用一个贯穿全程、带有 bash 工具的有状态编码智能体在每个训练周期持续重写技能指令，并结合多次尝试与无筛选接受策略，在不改动底层模型的前提下提升智能体的基准测试表现。
en_tdlr: EvoSkill v2 introduces a fully agentic skill evolution system whose key innovation is a persistent, stateful coding agent that rewrites an agent's skill instructions each epoch—replacing fragmented single-call or restart-based designs—to improve benchmark performance without modifying the underlying model or harness.
